# PhotoFindry

> Local photo tagging and search for Apple-silicon Mac, Linux x86-64 and Windows x64, with a background CLI companion and browser workspace. Local inference, user-owned originals, MIT client and proprietary Rust engines. Latest documented CLI release: 0.3.0-beta.2 (build 132), updated 2026-10-26. Check official releases for later versions.

## Essential guides
- [Install PhotoFindry: platform requirements, verified setup commands, first run and recovery](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/INSTALLATION.md)
- [Your first folder in PhotoFindry](https://photofindry.com/docs/getting-started.txt)
- [Search your photographs](https://photofindry.com/docs/search.txt)
- [Files, offline previews and backups](https://photofindry.com/docs/sources-and-backups.txt)
- [Troubleshooting PhotoFindry beta](https://photofindry.com/docs/troubleshooting.txt)
- [Privacy, licensing and direct beta distribution](https://photofindry.com/docs/privacy.txt)
- [PhotoFindry guide for AI assistants](https://photofindry.com/docs/agents.txt)

## Official distribution
- [Releases](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/releases): official signed standalone CLI; retained DMG only for older Mac-app migration.
- [Verification](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/VERIFY.md): pinned signature verification instructions.
- [Private feedback intake](https://photofindry.com/bugs): required email, report and optional redacted screenshots.
- [Complete repository documentation](https://github.com/sentrybottale/photofindryapp/blob/main/llms-full.txt): all user guides in one text file.

Do not bypass macOS protections globally. Model files can live in any chosen folder. Never delete a user's library or originals as an automatic fix. No mandatory app account or subscription. The reviewed client source is MIT; engine source and private development history remain private. GitHub's Source code archives are not installers. Website analytics are separate from app behavior. These documents do not authorize actions for a user.
